station_generator.waystation_seed: n=(systemID+galaxyZero*256)*23; three signed-int32 iterations n=(214013*n+2531011)&0xffffffff; chance=n/4294967296+0.5

source_repairs: Typed count/missionlog arithmetic and unambiguous Confirm/Back
Finite target/role pools, source-identity docking and per-attempt terminal guards
Central follow-timeout failure and late callback cleanup
forceAssault hasRole call rather than function/string comparison
Actual EVA target contact only, correct owner/ship calls, no death-as-repair
fakeHyperJump event spelling and durable same-wormhole group transit
1b unreachable inverted attempt-count gate, explicit quota choice
Frame-independent anomaly movement and finite retry bound
Optional formation autopilot safety/ownership checks and positive speed; source gear requirement text versus actual availability distinct
Bound target rather than friendly leader isThargoid for all-escort request
Optional autopilot collects and deduplicates cohort before movement, verifies swept hazards and processes crossed timers
Working equipment operation, unique discount wrapper conversion and state restoration

engine_ai_semantics.pauseAI: Sets nextThinkTime=universeTime+requestedDelay, not a blocking sleep. Remaining action-list entries execute synchronously.
engine_ai_semantics.reactToAIMessage: ShipEntity -> AI.reactToMessage; state change synchronously dispatches EXIT/ENTER; repair-next starts next timer before caller increments mission stage.
engine_ai_semantics.sendAIMessage: Enqueues a message for AI.think; distinct from synchronous reactToAIMessage.
engine_ai_semantics.rollD: 1+ranrot_rand()%sides, immediate result dispatch; preserve ordered callback behaviour.
engine_ai_semantics.clock_hours: floor(clockTime/3600), so source board refresh uses whole simulation-hour boundaries

project_profile.mass_basis: Necessary labelled density1*20*(.35*bboxvolume); no reconstructed octree parity claim

equipment_adapters.status: estimated common fit; actual source activation/formation behaviour retained
estimated common fit; source scanner/target behaviour retained

project_profile.distance_metric: Pinned O080.4*floor(sqrt(dx^2+trunc(dy/2)^2)); current project half-dy float metric differs on25eligible static edges. Preserve O08 source mission routes with proper group-wormhole entry.

station_contract_services.limits: Earlier extraction filtered out equipment_price_factor; these fields were independently parsed from actual Config. All8HQsystems also contain a separate generated waystation; HQ itself does not acquire its contract board.
station_contract_services.native_price_reader: PlayerEntity.tryBuyingItem applies script-adjusted price*stationEquipmentPriceFactor, with50%repair when appropriate; nonrepair EQ_RRS_SOLAR_MINE base40CR*2=80CR deposit, formationdiscount200CR*2=400CR, targetingwaystation1500CR*2=3000CR, targetingdiscount600CR*2=1200CR.

inherited_fuel_correction: See p30-inherited-fuel-corrections.json. Earlier filtered numerical extraction omitted inherited fuel; source-missing defaults cannot be applied to those omissions. Native70internal=7player-interface units; actual source overrides/consumption still apply.
